findings.summary: Dark preference leaves the page unchanged
findings.evidence: Dark-emulated and normal screenshots are pixel-identical; computed colorScheme is "normal".
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and use prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() for surfaces and text.

findings.summary: Reduced motion is only partially honoured
findings.evidence: The homepage chat transitions are disabled, but standings CSS contains an infinite blinkText animation with no reduced-motion override.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable all non-essential animations, including blinkText, inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Contrast preferences and minimum contrast are not robust
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails color-contrast; authored CSS has no forced-colors or prefers-contrast adaptation.
findings.suggestedFix: Meet WCAG contrast and add forced-colors/prefers-contrast-safe control styles.

findings.summary: Route and state changes are abrupt
findings.evidence: The DOM/CSS probe found no authored view-transition rules across the sampled templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions for MPA navigation, with reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Navigation chrome does not respond to scroll state
findings.evidence: Screenshots and CSS show a fixed-size 1000px header/menu and no scroll-state query or progress cue.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state container queries or a lightweight progress/shrinking-header treatment where useful.

findings.summary: Dropdowns and tooltips use brittle absolute coordinates
findings.evidence: CSS positions submenu at fixed top/left values and sends .htmltooltip to -1000px; no anchor positioning or fallback positions are authored.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover plus CSS anchor positioning and position-try fallbacks.

findings.summary: The chat overlay is an ad-hoc modal
findings.evidence: The probe finds zero dialog/popover elements while #chatOverlay/#chatPanel implement modal-like behavior with divs.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> for the modal chat panel or popover for non-modal disclosure, preserving focus and light-dismiss semantics.

findings.summary: Dense chrome competes with the core scores
findings.evidence: The first viewport devotes substantial space to a branded stadium header, two navigation rows and promotional/social controls before the results.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce repeated chrome and prioritize the current scores and filters in the first viewport.

findings.summary: Mobile receives a scaled-down 1000px desktop layout
findings.evidence: At viewport 360x800 the layout reports no viewport meta, a 1021px layout viewport and body min-width:1000px; text and controls are miniaturized.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a responsive viewport meta tag, remove min-width:1000px/fixed wrappers, and use intrinsic fluid layout.

findings.summary: Components do not adapt to their containers
findings.evidence: The probe found no @container rules; tables and wrappers use fixed widths from 880px to 1000px across templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Refactor reusable tables, menus and cards around container queries and intrinsic sizing.

findings.summary: Touch targets and some focus states are inadequate
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails target-size; sampled navigation links are about 16px high and several hidden/custom links report no visible outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide at least 24px spaced targets, visible :focus-visible styles and non-hover submenu access.

findings.summary: The error route gives no useful recovery state
findings.evidence: The exercised unknown route returned a generic page/state without a clearly documented retry or return path in the captured DOM.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve an intentional 404 with a clear message, home/search links and preserved site navigation.

findings.summary: Lab Core Web Vitals are poor
findings.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse reports LCP 10.1s and CLS 0.211; performance score is 0.60.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP element, reserve space for late content and reduce image/network competition.

findings.summary: The page shifts during load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports CLS 0.211 and the image audit finds 30 images without dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve image/ad space with width/height or aspect-ratio and use stable font fallbacks.

findings.summary: Critical delivery is delayed by a wide dependency surface
findings.evidence: HAR records 115 requests, 3.39MB transferred and ten parser-blocking CSS/JS candidates; Lighthouse LCP is 10.1s.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline/stream critical CSS, defer non-critical scripts and ads, and prioritize only the LCP asset.

findings.summary: Legacy and third-party code dominates avoidable work
findings.evidence: The DOM ships jQuery 1.8-era assets and repeated CSS rules; HAR includes 64 third-party requests and 1.41MB third-party bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused legacy jQuery/UI code, deduplicate CSS and load third parties only after user value is established.

findings.summary: Many controls and images lack accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails image-alt, link-name, select-name, table header and main-landmark audits; image probe finds 90 images without alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Add meaningful alt text, names/labels, table headers/captions and semantic landmarks.

findings.summary: Text does not consistently meet contrast minimums
findings.evidence: Lighthouse color-contrast audit fails on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to WCAG AA ratios in every table and navigation state.

findings.summary: Document structure and focus semantics are incomplete
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails heading order and main landmark; focus probe finds custom/hidden links without visible outlines.
findings.suggestedFix: Create a logical heading hierarchy, add landmarks and define strong :focus-visible states.

findings.summary: Mobile text is rendered at an unreadably small scale
findings.evidence: The 360px screenshots show the entire 1000px table scaled to the phone, making labels and scores extremely small.
findings.suggestedFix: Use responsive typography and reflow tables into readable rows/cards at narrow widths.

findings.summary: The page does not reflow at mobile width
findings.evidence: No viewport meta is present; fixed minimum widths force scale-to-fit and Lighthouse fails target-size.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow user scaling, add viewport meta, remove fixed minimum widths and test 320 CSS px / 400% zoom reflow.

findings.summary: Document and image fundamentals are invalid
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports no HTML doctype, incorrect image aspect ratios and low-resolution images; image probe finds 30 missing dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Add <!doctype html>, preserve intrinsic image aspect ratios and declare dimensions.

findings.summary: Browser platform hygiene has known failures
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports inspector issues, three BFCache failure reasons, and the page depends on very old jQuery/UI assets.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve DevTools issues/BFCache blockers and replace stale dependencies with current platform APIs.

findings.summary: Some links are not crawlable and the page is not mobile friendly
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails crawlable anchors and the viewport meta is absent; many image-only anchors have no descriptive text.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href links with descriptive names and add a responsive viewport meta tag.

findings.summary: Robots points to the wrong domain sitemap
findings.evidence: robots.txt allows crawling but declares four sitemap URLs on goal5.co rather than goal7.co.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct robots.txt sitemap URLs, add a canonical URL and verify sitemap/robots consistency.

findings.summary: Rich entity/share metadata is absent
findings.evidence: The homepage represents an organization and live sports data, but the probe found no JSON-LD and no Open Graph metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Organization/WebSite and relevant sports-event structured data plus Open Graph cards.

findings.summary: Session cookies and response defenses are insecure
findings.evidence: Headers probe finds no CSP/HSTS/nosniff; PHPSESSID lacks Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite protection.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax/Strict on the session cookie and deploy CSP, HSTS and nosniff headers.

findings.summary: Tracking and advertising footprint is excessive by default
findings.evidence: Trackers probe finds Google Tag Manager/Analytics plus eight third-party origins; HAR records 64 third-party requests and 1.41MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimize analytics, gate non-essential ads/trackers behind consent, batch events and self-host where practical.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defenses are not configured
findings.evidence: Headers probe reports missing clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy in addition to CSP/HSTS gaps.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and a nonce/hash-based CSP.

findings.summary: Failure recovery is not intentionally presented
findings.evidence: The unknown-route exercise did not expose an actionable recovery state; live data surfaces provide no captured retry/offline affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement explicit loading, stale, timeout and error states with retry and navigation recovery.

findings.summary: The Thai document does not declare its language
findings.evidence: The recon probe reports htmlLang as empty and Lighthouse fails html-has-lang; CSS relies heavily on left/right physical properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang="th", declare direction, and migrate layout spacing/positioning to logical properties.

findings.summary: Locale-sensitive schedule data lacks explicit semantics
findings.evidence: Rendered dates/times are plain text with no <time> semantics or documented locale formatting in the inspected DOM.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit <time datetime> values and format dates/numbers through Intl for the active Thai locale.

findings.summary: Global match times do not state a time zone
findings.evidence: Live and scheduled match tables show bare HH:MM values for worldwide events without a visible zone or machine-readable timestamp.
findings.suggestedFix: Store instants unambiguously and render localized times with a visible zone/date context.

findings.summary: Interactive vote controls are not labelled for humane validation
findings.evidence: The page probe finds repeated radio groups with zero associated labels and submit controls with no accessible label.
findings.suggestedFix: Associate labels/fieldset/legend, validate after interaction and announce errors in a live region.

findings.summary: Image delivery is highly wasteful
findings.evidence: Image probe finds 99/100 legacy-format images, 18 oversized images, 27 below-fold images not lazy-loaded and 30 without dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Convert decorative assets to AVIF/WebP/SVG, provide responsive sources and lazy-load below-fold media.

findings.summary: The initial load performs excessive non-core work
findings.evidence: HAR records 115 requests including analytics, advertising and large banners before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer ads/analytics and background fetches until idle, consent or user intent; remove redundant requests.

findings.summary: Third-party and animated media exceed a proportionate budget
findings.evidence: Third parties transfer 1.41MB; multiple animated GIF banners are among the largest resources, including a 441KB GIF.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget, replace animated GIFs with efficient video/static formats and defer promotional media.

findings.summary: The initial page has a large DOM/heap footprint
findings.evidence: Heap summary reports about 294k nodes and 19.7MB self size for the initial homepage state.
findings.suggestedFix: Paginate or virtualize long score tables and defer offscreen sections with content-visibility.

Add explicit failure and recovery states
Add user preference theming and motion/contrast coverage
